Maibatsu Penumbra FF '97 (Paul Walker Tribute) — GTA 6 guide

Confirmed by multiple launch guides · not personally verified Vespucci Island, Rialto Islands

A bright green movie-famous coupe sleeps in a villa garage on an island between the city and the beach.

Full guide — contains spoilers

On Vespucci Island, one of the Rialto Islands between Vice City and Vice Beach, find the villa near the middle of the island with a white gate facing its garage (one guide places the house on Neptune Circle, behind a tall hedge). Break into the garage and switch off the alarm on the wall left of the entrance, then open the door: inside is the green 1997 Maibatsu Penumbra FF with blue graphics and the plate 'HAD YOU', a tribute to Paul Walker's Eclipse from The Fast and the Furious. Entry is by smashing a window and hotwiring, or quieter with the Slim Jim (Chapter 2) or Snap Gun (Chapter 3). It has no tracker and comes pre-fitted with upgrades (acceleration rated 7.6/10), with 2 storage slots. Warning: registering any stolen car with Moses requires a respray, which strips this car's unique movie livery, so decide whether you want it as a keeper or as a collector's piece first. Registration is $6,750 if you miss the free slot — and it must be registered with Moses early on; Pay 'n' Spray registration only opens in Chapter 3 (one guide's 'register at a Pay 'n' Spray' line is wrong for the early game).

Source & evidence

Source: GTA 6 Free Cars — Paul Walker Tribute and Hidden Cars — DigitalNexus.

Evidence: Free-cars round-up corroborating GamesRadar, GTABase and Game8 on the villa garage, alarm switch and plate. Garage, alarm-switch method, plate 'HAD YOU' and $6,750 registration confirmed by GamesRadar, GTABase, Game8 and DigitalNexus. (Outlets calling the car a 'Mitsubishi Eclipse' are using the real-world car's name; in-game it is the Maibatsu Penumbra FF '97.)
